description: The plot illustrates the results of DPR with corpus, document, and asymmetric expansion on the dev set of MS-Marco. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)." and uses a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10, with numeric tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and uses a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains four solid lines. The line representing "DPR w/o query" is black with no markers and remains completely flat at a value of approximately 34.2 from x=1 to x=10. The line for "DPR w/ corpus expansion" is red with circular markers; it starts at approximately 35.2 at x=1, rises to a peak of roughly 35.7 at x=6, and remains steady to end at 35.7 at x=10. The line for "DPR w/ document expansion" is green with upward-pointing triangular markers; it begins at approximately 34.8 at x=1, dips to 34.6 at x=2, and ends at 34.5 at x=10. The line for "DPR w/ asymmetric expansion" is blue with downward-pointing triangular markers; it starts at approximately 34.7 at x=1, reaches a slight peak of 34.8 at x=5, and declines to end at 34.2 at x=10.
